examples: Many personal unions were ended by differences in the monarchies' rules of dynastic succession, while disputes thereabout lead to dynastic wars.
The Congo Free State was an independent kingdom in central Africa in personal union with Belgium under King Leopold.
wiktionary.gloss: The situation of two or more states sharing the same monarch, usually also with shared dynastic succession.
Hypostatic union; the union of Christ's humanity and divinity in one individual existence (person).

blocks.etymology: From pistol + -graph.
vi_block: Máy ảnh có tay cầm.

wiktionary.gloss: A photograph taken by means of pistolgraphy.

thesaurus.definition: set into opposition or rivalry

examples: After tripping, Sara tried to play her embarrassment off by laughing with everyone else.
Although he's obviously hungover, he's trying to play it off as food poisoning.
wiktionary.gloss: To portray (something) (as unimportant); to dismiss or make light of (a factor in a situation, or one's embarrassment about it); to pretend not to be embarrassed, upset, impressed, or otherwise affected by (it).

examples: Stalin's propensity to play off his subordinates against one another is a well-studied theme.
wiktionary.gloss: To set (other people) against one another: to induce competition between them, especially in a covert way so that they do not realize the degree to which they have been played (manipulated).
To compete in a play-off; to compete against (an opponent) in a play-off.

examples: to play off tricks
wiktionary.gloss: To display; to show; to put in exercise.

examples: Dozens of unworked obsidian cobbles were found buried with the deceased.
wiktionary.gloss: Describing an unaltered material found associated with human tool-making or other cultural activity.
